# Chips

Chips are small, interactive elements used to display information, trigger actions, or allow selections. Available in 2 styles, 3 sizes, with rounded, on-color, and selected variants.

**Stylesheet:** `components/chips/chips.css`

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## Props / Configuration

All available CSS classes and HTML attributes for configuring chip components.

| Class / Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.chip` | CSS class | Required | Base chip class. Must be applied to all chips. |
| `.chip-primary` | CSS class | — | Primary brand-colored chip style with green tones. |
| `.chip-neutral` | CSS class | — | Neutral gray chip style for general-purpose use. |
| `.chip-medium` | CSS class | — | Medium size (24px height). |
| `.chip-small` | CSS class | — | Small size (20px height). |
| `.chip-rounded` | CSS class | — | Applies full pill/rounded shape to the chip. |
| `.selected` | CSS class | — | Visual selected state. Changes to filled background. |
| `.chip-on-color` | CSS class | — | Modifier for dark/colored backgrounds. Inverts chip colors for contrast. |
| `.chip-icon-only` | CSS class | — | Square chip containing only an icon (no label text). |
| `disabled` | HTML attr | `false` | Disables the chip. Grays out appearance and prevents interaction. |
| `aria-pressed` | HTML attr | — | Set to "true" for chips in selected state. |

## Chip Styles

The two core chip styles. Primary for brand-colored selections and Neutral for general-purpose use.

```html
<button class="chip chip-primary">Primary</button>
<button class="chip chip-neutral">Neutral</button>
```

## Chip Sizes

Three size options to fit different contexts. Large (32px) is the default, Medium (24px) for denser layouts, and Small (20px) for compact usage.

```html
<button class="chip chip-primary">Large (32px)</button>
<button class="chip chip-primary chip-medium">Medium (24px)</button>
<button class="chip chip-primary chip-small">Small (20px)</button>



<button class="chip chip-neutral">Large (32px)</button>
<button class="chip chip-neutral chip-medium">Medium (24px)</button>
<button class="chip chip-neutral chip-small">Small (20px)</button>
```

## Rounded Chips

Apply the rounded modifier for a pill-shaped appearance. Works with all styles and sizes.

```html
<button class="chip chip-primary chip-rounded">Large</button>
<button class="chip chip-primary chip-rounded chip-medium">Medium</button>
<button class="chip chip-primary chip-rounded chip-small">Small</button>



<button class="chip chip-neutral chip-rounded">Large</button>
<button class="chip chip-neutral chip-rounded chip-medium">Medium</button>
<button class="chip chip-neutral chip-rounded chip-small">Small</button>
```

## Chip States

Interactive states that provide visual feedback. Hover and press states are handled by CSS pseudo-classes. Selected and Disabled states are set via classes and attributes.

```html
<button class="chip chip-primary">Default</button>
<button class="chip chip-primary selected" aria-pressed="true">Selected</button>
<button class="chip chip-primary" disabled="">Disabled</button>



<button class="chip chip-neutral">Default</button>
<button class="chip chip-neutral selected" aria-pressed="true">Selected</button>
<button class="chip chip-neutral" disabled="">Disabled</button>
```

## Selected State

Chips in selected state show a filled background to indicate active selection. Useful for filter groups and multi-select scenarios.

```html
<button class="chip chip-primary selected" aria-pressed="true">Large</button>
<button class="chip chip-primary chip-medium selected" aria-pressed="true">Medium</button>
<button class="chip chip-primary chip-small selected" aria-pressed="true">Small</button>



<button class="chip chip-neutral selected" aria-pressed="true">Large</button>
<button class="chip chip-neutral chip-medium selected" aria-pressed="true">Medium</button>
<button class="chip chip-neutral chip-small selected" aria-pressed="true">Small</button>



<button class="chip chip-primary chip-rounded selected" aria-pressed="true">Primary</button>
<button class="chip chip-neutral chip-rounded selected" aria-pressed="true">Neutral</button>
```

## On-Color

Chips placed on dark or colored backgrounds use the on-color modifier to ensure sufficient contrast. Colors are inverted to white/light tones.

```html
<button class="chip chip-primary chip-on-color">Default</button>
<button class="chip chip-primary chip-on-color selected" aria-pressed="true">Selected</button>
<button class="chip chip-primary chip-on-color" disabled="">Disabled</button>



<button class="chip chip-neutral chip-on-color">Default</button>
<button class="chip chip-neutral chip-on-color selected" aria-pressed="true">Selected</button>
<button class="chip chip-neutral chip-on-color" disabled="">Disabled</button>



<button class="chip chip-primary chip-on-color chip-rounded">Primary</button>
<button class="chip chip-primary chip-on-color chip-rounded selected" aria-pressed="true">Selected</button>
<button class="chip chip-neutral chip-on-color chip-rounded">Neutral</button>
<button class="chip chip-neutral chip-on-color chip-rounded selected" aria-pressed="true">Selected</button>
```

## RTL Support

Chips in right-to-left layout for Arabic and other RTL languages. Icon positions are mirrored automatically.

```html
<button class="chip chip-primary">اختيار</button>
<button class="chip chip-primary selected" aria-pressed="true">اختيار</button>
<button class="chip chip-primary chip-rounded">اختيار</button>
<button class="chip chip-primary"><span class="chip__icon"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
            <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10 3a1 1 0 011 1v5h5a1 1 0 110 2h-5v5a1 1 0 11-2 0v-5H4a1 1 0 110-2h5V4a1 1 0 011-1z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
        </svg></span>إضافة</button>
```
